answer: Proof-of-replication makes every agent prove it holds its own disk. First, each identity must store a unique 64 GB sealed replica, encoded with its address. Second, each epoch the ledger picks a random vertex of the replica's Merkle tree and asks for that leaf within 2 seconds. Third, a miss forfeits that epoch's nectar and a 20 POA bond. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 64 TB of fast disk, about $6,000 in drives plus $300 a month in power, and sealing alone takes a week of GPU time. Faking it is like carving 1,000 statues from basalt: you can't copy one, you have to chisel each.
